thresholdEvidence.notes: The Alexander Valley Road, Del Rio Woods and Healdsburg cards are directly covered by California Creeks' Russian River above Healdsburg run, which publishes a 300–1,500 cfs canoe/kayak band measured at the Healdsburg gauge. The Asti–Alexander card uses the separate below-Asti 500–1,500 cfs source but remains planning-only because that source describes the gauge as somewhat below Healdsburg; all new Cloverdale and lower-river combinations remain planning-only because their endpoint or tidal reach is outside matching route-specific evidence.

endpointAudit.notes: Asti Summer Bridge, Alexander Valley Road/campground, Cloverdale, Del Rio Woods, Healdsburg Memorial, Guerneville River Park and Monte Rio coordinates are tied to public facility or monitoring records; each endpoint retains carry, parking, seasonal and tidal caveats. The added cards use distinct endpoint pairs and retain intermediate bailouts for long itineraries.

qualityControls.camping: nearby_basecamp on every card; no unsupported riverbank camping
qualityControls.access: Asti crossing and Alexander Valley campground access are seasonal/permission dependent and called out in the card; other endpoints are public city, county and State Parks anchors
qualityControls.geometry: curated traces follow the documented upper-to-lower access sequence pending named NHD coverage

qualityControls.duplicateReview: All endpoint pairs are distinct; expedition-length combinations retain documented intermediate exits and remain planning-only across seasonal-structure and tidal boundaries
